sentences.sentence: A closely related theory sees theater as evolving out of dances that are primarily pantomimic, rhythmical or gymnastic, or from imitations of animal noises and sounds.
sentences.translation: 另外一相关理论认为，戏剧主要是从哑剧舞蹈、有节奏的舞蹈、体操、或动物声音的模仿过程中逐渐演变而来。

sentences.sentence: “It underscores the importance of subglacial methanogenesis,” Skidmore said.
sentences.translation: 他表示：“这一发现凸显了冰川下产甲烷菌的重要性。”

sentences.sentence: They discovered that during the same 14-month period that 1.7 cubic km of water cascaded through subglacial waterways, the 75-km long glacier downstream pick up speed, moving about 10 percent faster.
sentences.translation: 通过比较，研究人员发现，在14个月的时间中，冰层下湖泊溢出了1.7立方千米的水，75公里长的伯德冰川的移动速度加快了10%。

sentences.sentence: How a wave could have reached such a height remains speculative, but scientists studying the aftermath observed that a subglacial lake behind Lituya Glacier had dropped 100 feet in depth.
sentences.translation: 波浪达到如此之高的机理尚在思考中，而进行灾后研究的科学工作者观测到在Lituya冰河后面，一个冰下湖下沉了100英尺。

sentences.sentence: As the frequency of the rubbing reaches that at which the bowl naturally vibrates, the bowl's edge begins rhythmically to change shape, from one slightly oval shape into another.
sentences.translation: 当摩擦的频率达到了碗自身的振动频率时，碗的边缘便会有节奏地改变形状，从一个略微的椭圆形变成另一个略微的椭圆形。

sentences.sentence: Researchers found that highly familiar song lyrics and formulaic phrases expressed rhythmically had a strong impact on articulation – regardless of whether they were sung or spoken.
sentences.translation: 研究人员发现，有节奏的表达非常熟悉的歌词以及公式化的短语，无论是唱或是说，都对清晰发音有很大的影响。

sentences.sentence: I don’t doubt her sincerity, but I think she’s got her facts wrong.
sentences.translation: 我不怀疑她的诚意，但我认为她没弄清楚事实。

sentences.sentence: May I say in all sincerity that we could not have achieved this much without your help and support.
sentences.translation: 请允许我真心诚意地说: 没有你们的帮助和支持，我们就不可能取得这样的成绩。

sentences.sentence: But that brings us back to the excessive cleverness (and opacity) that we hope to avoid.

sentences.sentence: Between cleverness and wisdom, I prefer the latter.
sentences.translation: 在聪明与智慧之间我更喜欢后者。

sentences.translation: 软鞋是由概括的皮革，类似莫卡辛。

sentences.sentence: For tasks that execute code in a loop, it is common to check for interruption only once per loop iteration.
sentences.translation: 对于执行一个循环中的代码的任务，通常只需为每一个循环迭代检查一次中断。

sentences.sentence: Arranged chronologically, it begins with the novel’s primordial period — everything up to 1800 — and then marches century by century into the present.
sentences.translation: 按年代排列，它开始于小说的产生时期--一切回溯到1800年--然后一个世纪一个世界的进行到现在。

sentences.sentence: This means that data may appear two or more times in the log, but as the log is chronologically advancing, the most recent data is viewed as the active data.
sentences.translation: 这意味着数据可能在日志中出现两次或更多次，但是由于日志是按时间先后顺序发展的，最近的数据被视作活动数据。

sentences.translation: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 373 单元

teller
音标：英 /'telə/  美 /'tɛlɚ/
n. 讲话的人, 告诉的人
短语：bank teller — n. 银行行员
短语：automatic teller — 自动出纳机
短语：fortune teller — 算命先生；预言家
短语：automatic teller machine — 自动取款机；自动柜员机
短语：automated teller machine — 自动柜员机

abruptness
n. 唐突,粗鲁

pantomimic
adj. 哑剧的
例句：A closely related theory sees theater as evolving out of dances that are primarily pantomimic, rhythmical or gymnastic, or from imitations of animal noises and sounds.
另外一相关理论认为，戏剧主要是从哑剧舞蹈、有节奏的舞蹈、体操、或动物声音的模仿过程中逐渐演变而来。

slider
音标：英 /'slaɪdə/  美 /'slaɪdɚ/
n. 滑雪者, 滑冰者

subglacial
音标：英 /sʌb'gleɪʃ(ə)l; -sɪəl/  美 /sʌb'gleɪʃəl/
adj. 冰川下的
例句：“It underscores the importance of subglacial methanogenesis,” Skidmore said.
他表示：“这一发现凸显了冰川下产甲烷菌的重要性。”
例句：They discovered that during the same 14-month period that 1.7 cubic km of water cascaded through subglacial waterways, the 75-km long glacier downstream pick up speed, moving about 10 percent faster.
通过比较，研究人员发现，在14个月的时间中，冰层下湖泊溢出了1.7立方千米的水，75公里长的伯德冰川的移动速度加快了10%。
例句：How a wave could have reached such a height remains speculative, but scientists studying the aftermath observed that a subglacial lake behind Lituya Glacier had dropped 100 feet in depth.
波浪达到如此之高的机理尚在思考中，而进行灾后研究的科学工作者观测到在Lituya冰河后面，一个冰下湖下沉了100英尺。

cute
音标：英 /kjuːt/  美 /kjʊt/
adj. 可爱的, 聪明的
短语：cute girl — 可爱女孩
例句：a cute little puppy
一只逗人爱的小狗
例句：The baby’s so cute.
这婴儿真可爱。
例句：That’s a really cute outfit.
那套衣服真漂亮。

hike
音标：英 /haɪk/  美 /haɪk/
n&v. 徒步旅行
短语：price hike — 提价；物价上涨
短语：take a hike — 走路；滚开；哪凉快那歇着去
短语：hike up — 飘起
短语：tax hike — 赋税增加
短语：wage hike — n. 工资的增加
例句：a hike in the woods
林间远足

rhythmically
adv. 有节奏地
例句：Metal rollers clank rhythmically inside the Imperial Distributors warehouse, as employees slide boxes packed with health and beauty products down the lines.
 帝国经销公司的仓库里，随着员工把装满保健美容产品的箱子从货运线上拖下来，金属滚轴有节奏地叮当作响。
例句：As the frequency of the rubbing reaches that at which the bowl naturally vibrates, the bowl's edge begins rhythmically to change shape, from one slightly oval shape into another.
当摩擦的频率达到了碗自身的振动频率时，碗的边缘便会有节奏地改变形状，从一个略微的椭圆形变成另一个略微的椭圆形。
例句：Researchers found that highly familiar song lyrics and formulaic phrases expressed rhythmically had a strong impact on articulation – regardless of whether they were sung or spoken.
研究人员发现，有节奏的表达非常熟悉的歌词以及公式化的短语，无论是唱或是说，都对清晰发音有很大的影响。

sincerity
音标：英 /sɪn'serətɪ/  美 /sɪn'sɪərəti/
n. 诚挚, 真实
短语：in all sincerity — 非常真诚地；衷心地
例句：I don’t doubt her sincerity, but I think she’s got her facts wrong.
我不怀疑她的诚意，但我认为她没弄清楚事实。
例句：May I say in all sincerity that we could not have achieved this much without your help and support.
请允许我真心诚意地说: 没有你们的帮助和支持，我们就不可能取得这样的成绩。

cleverness
n. 聪明, 机灵
例句：Her cleverness and talent helped her look more beautiful than ever.
她的聪明才智使她更显得美貌非凡。
例句：But that brings us back to the excessive cleverness (and opacity) that we hope to avoid.
但是这又让我们回到了希望避免的聪明过度（和不透明性）上。
例句：Between cleverness and wisdom, I prefer the latter.
在聪明与智慧之间我更喜欢后者。

bombardment
音标：英 /bɒm'bɑːdm(ə)nt/  美 /bɑm'bɑrdmənt/
n. 炮击, 轰击
例句：The bombardment continued for a terrible nine hours.
轰炸可怕地持续了九个小时。

lounger
n. 漫步的人, 懒人

northward
音标：英 /'nɔːθwəd/  美 /'nɔrθwɚdz/
adv. 向北
adj. 向北的
例句：Tropical storm Marco is pushing northward up Florida's coast.
热带风暴“马可”正沿着佛罗里达海岸向北推进。
例句：The northward journey from Jalalabad was no more than 120 miles.
从贾拉拉巴德向北的行程不超过120英里。

dugout
音标：英 /'dʌgaʊt/  美 /'dʌɡaʊt/
n. 防空洞, 独木舟
例句：a dugout canoe
独木舟

moccasin
音标：英 /'mɒkəsɪn/  美 /'mɑkəsn/
n. 鹿皮鞋, 软拖鞋
例句：The soft shoe was made of wraparound leather, similar to a moccasin.
软鞋是由概括的皮革，类似莫卡辛。

interruption
音标：英 /ɪntə'rʌpʃn/  美 /,ɪntə'rʌpʃən/
n. 中断, 打断
短语：business interruption — 营业中断险
短语：service interruption — 断电，停电
短语：power interruption — 供电中断，电源中断；从电中断
短语：supply interruption — 供电中断
例句：For tasks that execute code in a loop, it is common to check for interruption only once per loop iteration.
对于执行一个循环中的代码的任务，通常只需为每一个循环迭代检查一次中断。

chronologically
音标：英 /krɔnə'lɔdʒikli/  美 /krɔnə'lɔdʒikli/
adj. 按年代的
例句：Arranged chronologically, it begins with the novel’s primordial period — everything up to 1800 — and then marches century by century into the present.
按年代排列，它开始于小说的产生时期--一切回溯到1800年--然后一个世纪一个世界的进行到现在。
例句：This means that data may appear two or more times in the log, but as the log is chronologically advancing, the most recent data is viewed as the active data.
这意味着数据可能在日志中出现两次或更多次，但是由于日志是按时间先后顺序发展的，最近的数据被视作活动数据。

activate
音标：英 /'æktɪveɪt/  美 /'æktə'vet/
v. 激活, 使活动
例句：Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。
例句：The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

episodic
音标：英 /,epɪ'sɒdɪk/  美 /,ɛpɪ'sɑdɪk/
adj. 插曲式的,短暂的
短语：episodic memory — 情景记忆，情节记忆；事件记忆
例句：...episodic attacks of fever.
...不定期的发烧。

fiord
音标：英 /fjɔːd/
n. (尤指挪威的)海湾, 峡湾
